name: Typeform
whatYouLose: Hosted response limits are replaced by your own hosting and backups
Dozens of native integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Sheets) you would wire by webhook
Built-in spam protection and accessibility auditing
prompt:
Build a one-question-at-a-time form builder, a Typeform replacement.

Stack: Astro (server output) + SQLite, vanilla JS for the form runner.
Features:
- Forms defined as JSON (question types: short text, long text, email, number, single choice, multi choice, rating 1-10, yes/no).
- Runner at /f/:id: one question per screen, Enter to advance, progress bar, smooth slide transitions, keyboard shortcuts A/B/C for choices.
- Conditional logic: "if answer to q3 is X, jump to q7".
- Responses saved to SQLite; admin table view with CSV export.
- Webhook POST on each submission, honeypot + rate limiting for spam.
- Admin at /admin protected by a password env var, with a JSON editor and live preview.
Done when: a sample 6-question form with one logic jump works end to end and exports CSV.
notes: The magic of Typeform is the interaction design, and a coding agent reproduces that well. Logic jumps and CSV export are the only real requirements for most teams.
